correctness.rationale: For G=K_m tensor K_n, distinct cells are adjacent iff both coordinates differ. Fix A the label-two support (size t); any outside cell can be labeled zero iff it has exactly one neighbor in A; all other outside cells must be one to minimize, giving exact canonical weight w(A)=mn+t-q(A). Single support gives mn+1-(m-1)(n-1)=m+n. For t=2 the three row/column positions each yield strict excess. For t>=3, row with s_i supports outside admits at most 0,n-1,2,1 eligible unselected cells for s_i=0,1,2,>=3 respectively, and at most one row has s_i=1. Hence q<=n+2m-3 and sym q<=m+2n-3, so equality forces t=3=m=n. In 3x3, q=6 requires exactly one selected per row and column, yielding 3!=6 extra permutation supports plus 9 singletons, 15 minima. Independent bitmask exhaustive supports at (3,3),(3,4),(3,5),(4,3),(4,4),(5,3) verified value/count; universal proof is the row bounds, not enumeration.
